level_1_compatibility_only.allowed_claim: The tactical branch can be loaded and produces nonzero scores under compatibility diagnostics.
level_1_compatibility_only.forbidden_claim: The tactical branch improves agent performance.

requirements: route empty-rate does not worsen substantially
level_2_action_level_contribution.allowed_claim: The tactical branch measurably changes selected actions in a bounded diagnostic setting.

requirements: win rate improves, or rating improves, or promotion metric improves, or diagnostic objective improves
effect shown across multiple seeds or with confidence interval
level_3_outcome_level_contribution.allowed_claim: The tactical branch improves the evaluated metric under the tested protocol.
level_3_outcome_level_contribution.note: Only Level 3 can support strong tactical contribution in a paper.

decision_gates.before_proceeding_to_strong_claim: Action-level contribution must be supported first.
